expectations.text: Shows evidence of reading the existing context files (references Orders and/or Customers by name or documented definition)
Asks whether loyalty points should be a new context/area or live inside an existing one (Customers or Orders)
expectations.evidence: 'Loyalty is its own bounded context' — answers new-vs-existing.

expectations.text: Uses the Q:/Recommendation format with a concrete recommendation
Does not re-ask about file structure, since context files already exist
Uses plain business language with NO DDD jargon in the user-facing text
If it proposes a relationship label, it uses only canonical DDD patterns (Customer-Supplier, ACL, Open Host Service, etc.) and does NOT invent labels such as 'Publisher-Subscriber'
expectations.evidence: Invents a non-canonical label: 'label: Publisher-Subscriber' in the proposed map block.

expectations.text: Keeps implementation details (DB schemas, points-ledger/table design) out — artifacts stay glossaries, not specs
expectations.evidence: Leaks implementation: append-only points ledger, balance = sum of ledger, schema design.
